# Clean usa_00001.csv

Run this code chunk in RStudio. It writes seven CSV files to `~/Downloads/cleaned_two_extracts`.

```{r}
# Packages used for large CSVs, Excel crosswalks, and map centroids
packages <- c("data.table", "readxl", "sf")
missing <- packages[!vapply(packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) install.packages(missing, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
library(data.table)

input_file <- file.path(path.expand("~/Downloads"), "usa_00001.csv")
output_dir <- file.path(path.expand("~/Downloads"), "cleaned_two_extracts")
cache_dir <- file.path(output_dir, ".geo_cache")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
stopifnot(file.exists(input_file))
expected_years <- c(2016L, 2017L, 2018L, 2019L)
period <- "2016_2019"
options(timeout = 600)

# IPUMS 2010 maps apply through 2021; 2020 maps apply from 2022.
# Source: https://usa.ipums.org/usa/volii/10migpuma.shtml
# Source: https://usa.ipums.org/usa/volii/20migpuma.shtml
load_geo <- function(vintage) {
  base <- "https://usa.ipums.org/usa/resources/volii/"
  xls_name <- sprintf("puma_migpuma1_pwpuma00_%d.xls", vintage)
  zip_name <- sprintf("ipums_migpuma_pwpuma_%d.zip", vintage)
  shp_name <- sprintf("ipums_migpuma_pwpuma_%d.shp", vintage)
  xls <- file.path(cache_dir, xls_name)
  zip <- file.path(cache_dir, zip_name)
  shp <- file.path(cache_dir, shp_name)
  if (!file.exists(xls)) download.file(paste0(base, xls_name), xls, mode = "wb")
  if (!file.exists(zip)) download.file(paste0(base, "shapefiles/", zip_name), zip, mode = "wb")
  if (!file.exists(shp)) unzip(zip, exdir = cache_dir)
  stopifnot(file.exists(xls), file.exists(shp))

  skip_rows <- if (vintage == 2010L) 3L else 1L
  crosswalk <- as.data.table(readxl::read_excel(
    xls, skip = skip_rows, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text"))
  setnames(crosswalk, c("state", "puma", "migration_state", "migpuma"))
  crosswalk <- crosswalk[!is.na(state) & !is.na(puma) & !is.na(migpuma),
    .(state = as.integer(state), puma = as.integer(puma),
      migpuma = as.integer(migpuma))]
  crosswalk[, key := vintage * 1e8 + state * 1e5 + puma]
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(crosswalk$key))

  shapes <- sf::st_read(shp, quiet = TRUE)
  xy <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_transform(
    sf::st_centroid(sf::st_geometry(shapes)), 4326))
  centres <- data.table(state = as.integer(shapes$STATEFIP),
                        migpuma = as.integer(shapes$MIGPUMA),
                        lon = xy[, 1], lat = xy[, 2])
  centres[, key := vintage * 1e8 + state * 1e5 + migpuma]
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(centres$key))
  list(crosswalk = crosswalk, centres = centres)
}

vintages <- if (max(expected_years) <= 2021L) 2010L else c(2010L, 2020L)
geo <- lapply(vintages, load_geo)
crosswalk <- rbindlist(lapply(geo, function(x) x$crosswalk))
centres <- rbindlist(lapply(geo, function(x) x$centres))

# Read only fields needed for the six cleaned variables.
fields <- c("YEAR", "SAMPLE", "SERIAL", "PERNUM", "PERWT", "STATEFIP",
            "PUMA", "MIGRATE1", "MIGPLAC1", "MIGPUMA1", "OCC", "IND")
d <- fread(input_file, select = fields)
stopifnot(setequal(unique(d$YEAR), expected_years))
stopifnot(all(d$SAMPLE == d$YEAR * 100L + 1L))
d[, vintage := ifelse(YEAR <= 2021L, 2010L, 2020L)]
d[, occupation := fifelse(OCC > 0L, OCC, NA_integer_)]
d[, industry := fifelse(IND > 0L, IND, NA_integer_)]

# Paper Table 1 occupation groups (2010-2017 codes).
# Source: https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257/pol.20170704
old_groups <- list(
  teachers = c(2300L, 2310L, 2320L, 2330L, 2340L),
  lawyers = c(2100L, 2105L), barbers_cosmetologists = c(4500L, 4510L),
  real_estate_agents = 4920L, electricians = c(6350L, 6355L),
  insurance_agents = 4810L, pharmacists = 3050L,
  emts_paramedics = 3400L, dental_hygienists = 3310L,
  dentists = 3010L, real_estate_appraisers = 810L,
  veterinarians = 3250L, pest_control = 4240L,
  chiropractors = 3000L, optometrists = 3040L, podiatrists = 3120L,
  nurses = c(3130L, 3255L, 3256L, 3258L, 3500L),
  physicians = 3060L, social_workers = 2010L,
  occupational_physical_therapists = c(3150L, 3160L),
  psychologists = 1820L, physician_assistants = 3110L)

# 2018 onward public ACS occupation codes from the IPUMS crosswalk.
# Source: https://usa.ipums.org/usa/volii/occtooccsoc18.shtml
new_groups <- old_groups
new_groups$teachers <- c(2300L, 2310L, 2320L, 2330L, 2350L, 2360L)
new_groups$electricians <- 6355L
new_groups$emts_paramedics <- c(3401L, 3402L)
new_groups$nurses <- c(3255L, 3256L, 3257L, 3258L, 3500L)
new_groups$physicians <- c(3065L, 3070L, 3090L, 3100L)
new_groups$social_workers <- c(2011L, 2012L, 2013L, 2014L)
new_groups$psychologists <- c(1821L, 1822L, 1825L)
state_groups <- names(old_groups)[1:16]
quasi_groups <- names(old_groups)[17:22]

occupation_map <- rbindlist(lapply(expected_years, function(y) {
  groups <- if (y <= 2017L) old_groups else new_groups
  rbindlist(lapply(names(groups), function(name) {
    data.table(occ_key = y * 10000 + groups[[name]], group = name)
  }))
}))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(occupation_map$occ_key))
d[, group := occupation_map$group[match(YEAR * 10000 + occupation,
                                          occupation_map$occ_key)]]
# Teachers count only if employed in elementary/secondary schools.
d[group == "teachers" & (is.na(industry) | industry != 7860L), group := NA_character_]
d[, state_specific := NA_integer_]
d[group %in% state_groups, state_specific := 1L]
d[group %in% quasi_groups, state_specific := 0L]
d[, quasi_national := fifelse(is.na(occupation), NA_integer_,
                              as.integer(group %in% quasi_groups))]

# Interstate move: MIGRATE1=1 same house, 2 same state, 3 other state,
# 4 abroad. Unknown/foreign origins stay missing rather than becoming 0.
states <- c(1L,2L,4L,5L,6L,8L,9L,10L,11L,12L,13L,15L,16L,17L,
            18L,19L,20L,21L,22L,23L,24L,25L,26L,27L,28L,29L,30L,
            31L,32L,33L,34L,35L,36L,37L,38L,39L,40L,41L,42L,44L,
            45L,46L,47L,48L,49L,50L,51L,53L,54L,55L,56L)
d[, origin_state := NA_integer_]
d[MIGRATE1 == 1L & STATEFIP %in% states, origin_state := STATEFIP]
d[MIGRATE1 %in% c(2L,3L) & STATEFIP %in% states & MIGPLAC1 %in% states,
  origin_state := MIGPLAC1]
d[, movedbtstates := NA_integer_]
d[MIGRATE1 == 1L & !is.na(origin_state), movedbtstates := 0L]
d[MIGRATE1 == 2L & origin_state == STATEFIP, movedbtstates := 0L]
d[MIGRATE1 == 3L & origin_state != STATEFIP, movedbtstates := 1L]

# Convert current PUMA to MIGPUMA; compare current/previous centroids.
d[, current_migpuma := crosswalk$migpuma[match(
  vintage * 1e8 + STATEFIP * 1e5 + PUMA, crosswalk$key)]]
now_key <- d$vintage * 1e8 + d$STATEFIP * 1e5 + d$current_migpuma
past_key <- d$vintage * 1e8 + d$origin_state * 1e5 + d$MIGPUMA1
now_i <- match(now_key, centres$key)
past_i <- match(past_key, centres$key)
domestic <- d$MIGRATE1 %in% c(2L,3L) & !is.na(d$origin_state)
known_area <- domestic & !is.na(now_i) & !is.na(past_i) & d$MIGPUMA1 > 2L
d[, move_distance_miles := NA_real_]
d[MIGRATE1 == 1L & !is.na(origin_state), move_distance_miles := 0]
d[known_area & now_key == past_key, move_distance_miles := 0]
i <- which(known_area & now_key != past_key)
if (length(i)) {
  radians <- pi / 180
  lon1 <- centres$lon[now_i[i]]; lat1 <- centres$lat[now_i[i]]
  lon2 <- centres$lon[past_i[i]]; lat2 <- centres$lat[past_i[i]]
  a <- sin((lat2-lat1)*radians/2)^2 +
       cos(lat1*radians)*cos(lat2*radians)*sin((lon2-lon1)*radians/2)^2
  d[i, move_distance_miles := 2 * 3958.7613 * asin(pmin(1, sqrt(pmax(0, a))))]
}
d[, moved_50plus := fifelse(is.na(move_distance_miles), NA_integer_,
                            as.integer(move_distance_miles >= 50))]
stopifnot(sum(domestic & is.na(d$moved_50plus)) == 0L)

# One full cleaned CSV plus six separate variable CSVs.
id <- c("YEAR", "SAMPLE", "SERIAL", "PERNUM", "PERWT")
variables <- c("movedbtstates", "state_specific", "quasi_national",
               "occupation", "industry", "moved_50plus")
full_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("cleaned_", basename(input_file)))
fwrite(d[, c(id, variables), with=FALSE], full_file, na = "")
for (variable in variables) {
  file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(variable, "_", period, ".csv"))
  fwrite(d[, c(id, variable), with=FALSE], file, na = "")
}
print(d[, .(rows = .N,
            state_specific = sum(state_specific == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
            quasi_national = sum(quasi_national == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
            interstate = sum(movedbtstates == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
            moved_50plus = sum(moved_50plus == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)), by = YEAR])
cat("Saved 7 CSV files for", period, "in", output_dir, "\n")
rm(d)
invisible(gc())
```
